title: Theory that directed energy forces transdimensional objects into physical form

tellings.quote: by hitting it with like something like directed energy, you're forcing it to take form and become bound to this dimension.

plain: Jordan Jose, a man who says he was taken into a secret UFO program as a child, puts forward the idea that some craft come from another dimension, and that hitting them with directed energy, meaning focused beams of power, forces them "to take form and become bound to this dimension." He offers it as his own view, and if true it would explain how such objects could be pinned down and brought to the ground.
